text:
Noah: two-second game: drop your best one-liner in one sentence. go.
Lina: My coffee is the only thing holding my inbox hostage.
Omar: I put the "pro" in procrastinate.
Bea: Calendar says focus, brain says rerun the sitcom.
Kai: If plants could talk mine would file a complaint.
Noah: ok next rule  add one emoji that represents the delivery style.
Lina: :coffee:
Omar: :clock1:
Bea: :tv:
Kai: :seedling:
Noah: tiny prize: most reacted one-liner gets to name the office whiteboard doodle this week.
Lina: also, shoutout: @Kai kept the fire alarm from staging a full concert when it beeped earlier. hero status.
kudos-bot: Noah awarded +1 karma to Kai for calm under alarm.
Omar: heroic status confirmed. Kai for mayor of calm.
Bea: poll: quick Thursday treat? react :cookie: for cookies, :brownie: for brownies, :croissant: for croissants.
Noah: :cookie:
Lina: :brownie:
Omar: :croissant:
Kai: :cookie:
Bea: results in 30 min. winner supplies celebratory napkins. last one-liner bonus: restroom graffiti says "Only fold, never crumple." winner-by-popularity owes napkin origami lessons.
Noah: and scene. thanks for the rapid comedy show, team :clap:
